name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips or by your sides.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees, or as far as is comfortable.
Keep your chest upright and your front foot flat on the floor.
Push through your front foot to bring your back foot forward and stand tall, then repeat on the other side.
technique_considerations: Take a step long enough that your front knee stays roughly above your ankle.
Keep your hips square to the front.
Hold a wall or sturdy chair for balance if you need it.
